items.description: Docker dev environment with VS Code Server in the browser, SSH via coder ssh, persistent home.
Full XFCE desktop: brokered RDP through Guacamole, noVNC in the browser, native RDP via coder port-forward, plus VS Code.
Security tooling workspace for the cyber range. Defaults to the isolated (no-egress) network profile.
KVM/QEMU virtual machine via libvirt, RDP brokered through Guacamole. Requires a Windows licence seat.
